home.question: Why work with BrightByte Consulting?
home.answer: We connect software design, development and delivery in one process. Your team has clear milestones, regular reviews and a shared understanding of scope, priorities and technical decisions.

home.question: Which software services do you offer?
home.answer: Our services cover mobile and web development, AI integration, DevOps, ERP systems, technology reviews, project management, digital marketing and OEM sourcing, with scope agreed for each engagement.

home.question: How can I discuss a software project?
home.answer: Use the Contact page to share your goals, requirements and any existing systems. Our team will review the inquiry and arrange a discussion about scope, technical options and the next steps.

home.question: Can you provide a project estimate?
home.answer: Yes. Share the features, integrations and delivery priorities you have in mind. We review the requirements and assumptions before proposing an initial scope, delivery approach and indicative budget.

how-we-work.question: What delivery methodology does Brightbyte use?
how-we-work.answer: We plan delivery around milestones, reviews and testing. Sprint length, reporting and collaboration tools are agreed around your project and team responsibilities.

how-we-work.question: Who owns the code and intellectual property produced during sprints?
how-we-work.answer: Ownership, repository access, confidentiality and licensing are defined in the project agreement. We discuss these before work starts so both teams understand the deliverables and handover arrangements.

how-we-work.question: How quickly can Brightbyte kick off an engagement?
how-we-work.answer: Kickoff timing depends on the agreed scope, team availability and access to required systems. After discovery, we confirm the onboarding steps, delivery plan and an achievable start date with you.

how-we-work.question: Can BrightByte collaborate with our existing in-house team?
how-we-work.answer: Yes. We can support your existing team through staff augmentation or a dedicated delivery team, using agreed tools, review practices and communication channels to coordinate the work.
